structs.name: Umbra__Tome
structs.size_evidence: not a fixed-size struct. Load_UmbraTome@0x1418CBC20 stores the blob pointer (`*outTome = tomeData` through Umbra::Tome::init@0x141F94E40) and Umbra::Tome::init compares dataSize with the blob's own total size read from +8 (`result = *(unsigned int*)(tomeData+8)`). The object is the runtime blob (rgp_world->umbraTome). Replay's highest access is +80..+83 (DWORD), so the lower bound is 84 bytes. No fixed upper bound exists: the size is per instance, read from +8
members: Umbra::Tome::init@0x141F94E40: `*(DWORD*)tomeData != -1163018018` (header magic); Umbra::Tome::getStatus@0x141F94DA0 decodes the version bits of the same DWORD (0xD6xxxxxx)
Umbra::Tome::init@0x141F94E40: `result = *(unsigned int*)(tomeData+8)` is the blob size compared with dataSize. Rename proposal from m_headerWord8 (proof: this is the total size of the blob)

Umbra::Tome::getObjectUserIDs@0x141F94CA0: `if (objectIndex < 0 || objectIndex >= this[16]) return 0` (+64). Rename proposal from m_headerData64. Also read by Umbra_Visibility_getStatusWord@0x141F94C90 (returns +64 as a status word) for rgp_world->umbraTome in R_Umbra_QueryStaticVisibilityCmd@0x1418CDD20; that conflict is in notes

Umbra::Tome::getObjectUserIDs@0x141F94CA0: `v6 = this[19]` (+76) is a byte offset to a start/end pair table: `*(this+4*v4+v6+4) - *(this+4*v4+v6)` is the user-ID count. Rename proposal from m_objectUserIdCount (it is an offset, not a count)
Umbra::Tome::getObjectUserIDs@0x141F94CA0: when +76 is 0, `v13 = this[20]` (+80) is the byte offset to the int user-ID table indexed by objectIndex (`this + v13 + 4*objectIndex`)
changed_members: Umbra::Tome::getObjectUserIDs@0x141F94CA0 (+76 is a table offset, not a count)
unconfirmed: _pad4 (4..7), _padC (12..63), _pad44 (68..75), _pad54 (84..): no Replay access found; the blob is a runtime buffer. The IDA size 364 is not proven by Replay and the trailing 280 bytes are never read through this type
Umbra::ImpTome::getUserIDs@0x141F94E10 reads ImpTome members m_userIDs / m_userIDStarts (other struct, not Umbra__Tome): the user-ID table lives in a different struct
structs.notes: Size proposal: the honest type is a header view of 84 bytes (lower bound) whose total size is the DWORD at +8; the 364-byte fixed size should not be applied. Conflict: +64 is read as an object count (getObjectUserIDs bound) and also returned by Umbra_Visibility_getStatusWord (called with rgp_world->umbraTome, so the Tome). Both readings are Replay evidence; the name is kept as m_objectCount for now and the coordinator should decide. Misnamed function: 0x141F94C90 Umbra_Visibility_getStatusWord reads a Tome, not a Visibility (see renames).
